body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Prague, Czechia. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at Get Prague Guide, Maiselova, 5, Praha 1. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Prague Astronomical Clock. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Embark on an exploration of Prague, where the splendor of ancient architecture and the whispers of history are yours to discover. Your journey through Prague is inclusive of a ticket to the Prague Astronomical Clock, boasting a medley of medieval craftsmanship and astronomical precision to kickstart your voyage.
>
> Your adventure begins not far from the Astronomical Clock Tower, at the office of GET PRAGUE GUIDE at Maiselova 5 where you will need to show your smartphone voucher to the staff. Please be on time, the representative will hold the ticket for max. of 15 minutes after the starting time. Note that this tour includes an entrance ticket, but an audio guide inside the Tower is not provided!
>
> After you finish exploring the Tower on your own, unpause the tour and set off on a fascinating stroll through Prague’s famous landmarks. Your route weaves through the iconic Charles Bridge and ascends to the Prague Castle, with numerous awe-inspiring stops along the way including Baroque masterpieces such as St. Nicholas Church and heritage-rich locales like Clementinum, Charles Bridge, and Nerudova Street. Each landmark's narrative enriches your understanding of Prague's legacy.
>
> With this self-guided experience, travelers will uncover unforgettable moments, from the beauty of the Kampa Island to the sacred reverence at the St. Vitus Cathedral.
